class.name: FellowWind3D
class.brief_description: The scene's wind: grass, bushes and trees bend, sway and flutter with it and its gusts (FellowEngine).
class.description: The wind blows along the node's forward axis (-Z, projected on the ground plane) at [member speed]. Gusts — a noise field of cells of [member gust_size], twice as long along the wind, travelling with it — change its speed from place to place and in time by up to [member gustiness], so they roll over a meadow in waves. Materials move with it in the vertex shader (Forward+): a [BaseMaterial3D] with its Wind group on ([member BaseMaterial3D.wind]), or a [ShaderMaterial] with [code]render_mode fellow_wind;[/code] (its [code]vertex()[/code] can set [code]WIND_HEIGHT[/code], [code]WIND_BEND[/code], [code]WIND_FLUTTER[/code] and [code]WIND_SHEEN[/code]). Each mesh instance (a MultiMesh's instance or a node) is a plant standing at its origin: it bends with the wind's force (the square of its speed), more towards its top, and sways about that at a natural frequency of its size; vertices away from its stem (branches, a clump's blades) sway at their own phases; leaves flutter along their normals. The normals turn with the bend, and a sheen ([member BaseMaterial3D.wind_sheen]) brightens what is bent. The shadows and the motion vectors (TAA, motion blur) follow: the previous frame's wind is kept. A [FellowRain3D] in the scene takes its drops' wind from this node (its [member FellowRain3D.wind_from_scene]). One node at a time is active: the last one to enter the tree. Without one, materials with wind stand still. [code]rendering/fellow/fluid/enabled[/code] off stops the wind. The Mobile and Compatibility renderers do not move the vertices. Decision record [code]docs/decisions/0125-wind.md[/code]. In the editor the sway and the gusts move as in the running game; the 3D editor's toolbar toggle [b]Animate[/b] (the editor setting [code]editors/3d/fellow/animate_nodes[/code]) off holds them (milestone 52).

method.name: get_direction
method.description: The direction the wind blows to: the node's forward axis on the ground plane, normalized.

method.name: get_gust_texture
method.description: The gusts' tiling noise (red channel; 8 gust cells a side).

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: The mean wind's velocity in metres per second.

method.name: get_velocity_at
method.description: The wind's velocity at a point now, with the gust there (as the materials see it), in metres per second.

members.member: A scale of the leaves' flutter (the materials' [code]WIND_FLUTTER[/code]).
The size of a gust across the wind, in metres (twice as long along it).
How much the gusts change the wind's speed: between [code]1 - gustiness[/code] and [code]1 + gustiness[/code] times [member speed].
The mean wind's speed in metres per second (a breeze 3, a fresh wind 10, a gale 20).
The wind's clock in seconds (not saved): advanced by the process time with [member time_auto], or set here for deterministic renders.

If [code]true[/code], the wind's clock (the sway's phase, the gusts' travel) advances with the process time; otherwise it is set by the [member time] property (deterministic renders: the same pose for the same time).
